scope: Discovery of one finite construction; no universal or global optimality claim.

winning_frame_search.domain: 20 groups of existing dimension-eight helper ends with dimension-seven lower spaces under fixed scalar code and interfaces. Exact subspace refitting of B and early-cleanup frames.
winning_frame_search.stopping_rule: Select a legal word with positive complete packing headroom, obtain a literal owner map, and require unchanged full native and global admission.
winning_frame_search.minimalization: Retain only the eight B frames, two tail frames, and two ends necessary for the verified profile.
winning_frame_search.screen_only: Local cost and aggregate packing screens are not admitted kappa witnesses.

packing_search.owner_lineage: chafreaky PR685, reused by PR741 and adapted by G44Pack for PR799
packing_search.objective: feasibility; all nonempty physical bins are full
packing_search.rebinding: The first minimal end-pair word removed unrelated frame rechoices while preserving the search profile and helper widths. Later U8 composition changes the local paid profile but retains the entire helper-width vector, frozen flow and literal owners.
packing_search.required_admission: unchanged native local and strict global replay plus independent exact repricing

earlier_searches.domain: Both pinned words, fixed scalar order and fixed entrance/end interfaces; full induced GF(2)^9 subspace intervals in 140 components.
earlier_searches.result: No lower profile found. Integer-rounded moment objectives do not prove a universal real-objective optimum.

earlier_searches.domain: Legal local commuting reorders and exact adjacent shear rewrites with correction gates.
earlier_searches.result: No improved candidate passed the cost screen; these searches are not impossibility results.

earlier_searches.domain: Six E4-to-E5 entrance promotions, independently verified natively, plus uniform and small mixed owner inventories.
earlier_searches.result: Local savings did not overcome global packing cost. The new end dimensions change the width inventory and escape that restriction.

composition.method: Apply the same end subspace and eight B frames to the pinned U8 word. Its eight new early tails move the two affected tail entries from 140/141 to 148/149. All 504 helper widths otherwise match the prior end-pair candidate.
composition.independent_point_audit: Exact twelve-annotation difference and local delta {1:-6,2:+14,3:-8}; U8 scalar gates unchanged.
composition.owner_reuse: The full per-helper width vector is identical, so the frozen integer flow and literal owner payload remain valid. All roles, windows, charts, and controls are rechecked.
composition.scope: PR942 all-replica bound fixes the previous U8 profile and helper widths; this construction changes both.
